# Generated files

Created by `python run_context_reversal.py` with the committed configuration.

- `context_metrics.csv`: complete per-seed metrics (200 seeds x 4 agents x 4 reliability levels)
- `learning_curves.csv.gz`: compact periodic checkpoints for every run
- `context_summary.json`: hypotheses, definitions, summaries, seed intervals and paired effects
- `context_reversal.png` and `.svg`: the same four-panel overview in raster and editable vector formats

The outputs are deterministic for the declared Python dependencies and seeds.
